title: Infrastructure channel – chat excerpt (TLS certificate)
context_note: Partial export: 2 subsequent replies in the thread are not included.
content:
[18:22] Infrastructure engineer: Regarding the payment-gateway TLS certificate for the customer portal domain: renewal requires a signed CSR from the customer side. It is their domain and their CA account.

[18:23] Infrastructure engineer: I contacted someone at the customer last week, with no reply so far. It is unclear who owns this internally since the previous security contact left – possibly Security or the account team.

[18:24] Infrastructure engineer: The certificate expires on 20 March. If it lapses, card payments in the portal stop working.

[2 more replies not included in this export]
